cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.

mechanism: A protects its pupil hope of a time visitor with a small piece of evidence and reception tasks while keeping a discouraging calculation hidden.
confusable: Not generic encouragement: A selects proof, conceals the negative number and supplies concrete next preparation.
comparison: Covered numerical forecast versus selective reading of a paper-cloud forecast.
seedUse: D159 future visitor/chair/calculation/covered number; S05 checking observations before abandoning work.
